Hanno Chamber of Commerce offers free individual consultations with experts in August and September.

【August consultations】
• August 5 (Wed) 1:30 PM – Business succession and M&A consultation
• August 7 (Fri) 10:00 AM – Human resources and labor consultation
• August 17 (Mon) 1:30 PM – Japan Policy Finance Corporation consultation
• August 17 (Tue) 10:00 AM – Intellectual property consultation
• August 18 (Tue) 1:30 PM – Management and legal consultation

【September consultations】
• September 9 (Wed) 1:30 PM – Business succession and M&A consultation
• September 10 (Thu) 9:30 AM – Tax and invoice system free individual consultation
• September 11 (Fri) 10:00 AM – Human resources and labor consultation
• September 15 (Tue) 1:30 PM – Management and legal consultation and Japan Policy Finance Corporation consultation
• September 28 (Tue) 10:00 AM – Intellectual property consultation

Bookings must be made through the dedicated link by the morning of the 5th business day before each consultation date. Available to Chamber members only.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2618/
